description: Hewage Ariyaratne v. Subasinghage Heenhamy Hewage Ariyaratne v. Subasinghage Heenhamy View More before Hon. Rohini Marasinghe, J.
parties: Hewage Ariyaratne v. Subasinghage Heenhamy Hewage Ariyaratne v. Subasinghage Heenhamy View More
keywords: Respondent had filed a possessory action before the District Court of Embilipitiya over State land issued on a Mahaweli Authority permit in another person’s name. Held - Appeal allowed and District Court judgement set aside on the grounds that succession in a possessory action requires a plaintiff to prove both physical possession (detentio) and mental possession (animus possidendi), and the trial judge had incorrectly upheld the plaintiff’s (Respondent in the instant Application) claim based on intention alone.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
